lines.differs: Fairer to the vendor than Rohan Iyer: requires only a summary of hours instead of approved timesheets and reimburses all out-of-pocket expenses.
Fairer to the vendor than Trustline NBFC: requires payment within 30 days of invoice receipt rather than 45 days.
Harsher on the vendor than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: lacks interest of 12% per annum on delayed payments.
Harsher on the vendor than Rohan Iyer: assigns all work product intellectual property to the company instead of letting vendor retain ownership.
Same as Al Noor Hospitality Group: transfers intellectual property to the buyer upon payment while reserving the vendor's pre-existing tools.
Same as Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: transfers deliverables to the buyer upon full payment while allowing vendor to retain pre-existing tools.
Harsher on the vendor than Crestline Retail Inc: does not limit confidentiality obligations to three years after termination.
Fairer to the vendor than Rohan Iyer: omits specific client data-security rules and restrictions on downloading data to personal devices.
Fairer to the vendor than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: includes standard exclusions for publicly available, prior known, and independently developed information.
Fairer to the vendor than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: limits non-solicitation to employees worked with and permits general hiring advertisements.
Harsher on the vendor than Crestline Retail Inc: imposes a non-solicitation obligation on the vendor, whereas Crestline only restricted the buyer.
Harsher on the vendor than Rohan Iyer: includes an express IP non-infringement warranty and adds willful misconduct to liability cap exceptions.
Harsher on the vendor than Sunrise Foods: carves out confidentiality, fraud, and willful misconduct from the liability cap.
Fairer to the vendor than CareBridge Clinics Inc: caps aggregate liability at 1 times 12 months of fees rather than 2 times.
